why: B delivers the key piece the client asked for, a tall dark-wood bookcase close to the floor tone (though at 90 cm it fills only part of the wall), plus the round light jute rug, a proper reading lamp and a cohesive warm palette of cognac leather, walnut, jute and cream knit. A's bookcases are medium-height and medium-brown, its rug is a striped rectangle rather than round and light, and its bulky traditional wingback recliner feels heavy and out of style in this small modern room.
